title: Tide and Garden Again
author: Jude Thornbury
blurb: Silas Underhill, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
